rows.question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  -- ROOM_NUMBER: token after final space, dash or slash (or whole OFFICE_LOCATION if none)
  CASE
    WHEN ed.OFFICE_LOCATION REGEXP '[-/]' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION, '-', -1), '/', -1))
    WHEN ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION, ' ', -1))
    ELSE ed.OFFICE_LOCATION
  END AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  -- FLOOR_NUMBER: first sequence of digits found in the ROOM_NUMBER (if any)
  (CASE
     WHEN (CASE
             WHEN ed.OFFICE_LOCATION REGEXP '[-/]' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION, '-', -1), '/', -1))
             WHEN ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION, ' ', -1))
             ELSE ed.OFFICE_LOCATION
           END) REGEXP '[0-9]'
     THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(
            (CASE
               WHEN ed.OFFICE_LOCATION REGEXP '[-/]' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION, '-', -1), '/', -1))
               WHEN ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ed.OFFICE_LOCATION, ' ', -1))
               ELSE ed.OFFICE_LOCATION
             END),
            '[0-9]+'
     )
     ELSE NULL
   END) AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
  -- BUILDING_KEY: prefer matching FAC_BUILDING_KEY, then BUILDING_NUMBER, else raw OFFICE_LOCATION
  COALESCE(fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, ed.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS BUILDING_KEY,
  -- building street address, city, state, postal code:
  -- fac_building in the DDL provides BUILDING_NAME and some address-like fields (use BUILDING_NAME as fallback)
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), ed.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fb.SITE AS CITY,
  NULL AS STATE,
  NULL AS POSTAL_CODE
FROM drupal_employee_directory ded
JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON ed.FULL_NAME = ded.FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
     AND (fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION OR fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION)
WHERE ded.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
LIMIT 1

  fb.`BUILDING_NAME`,
  fba.`STREET_NAME` AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.`CITY`,
  fba.`STATE`,
  fba.`POSTAL_CODE`,
  fb.`BUILDING_HEIGHT`

-- The original error indicates fr.SECTION_ID didn't exist in fac_rooms; try joining on MASTER_SUBJECT_ID or SUBJECT_ID first,

       -- match by building keys/numbers if rooms are linked that way
       OR (fr.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND fr.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
       OR (fr.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND fr.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`)

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sections_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    s.SECTION_ID,
    s.TERM_CODE,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    s.MEET_PLACE,
    -- derive enrollment from possible columns; treat non-numeric/NULL as 0
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(s.ENROLLED_STUDENTS, '') + 0,
      NULLIF(s.ENROLLMENT, '') + 0,
      NULLIF(s.ENROLLED, '') + 0,
      0
    ) AS ENROLLED
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered s
  -- filter to rows that have >300 after converting possible text to number
  WHERE COALESCE(
      NULLIF(s.ENROLLED_STUDENTS, '') + 0,
      NULLIF(s.ENROLLMENT, '') + 0,
      NULLIF(s.ENROLLED, '') + 0,
      0
    ) > 300
),
parsed_place AS (
  SELECT
    se.SECTION_ID,
    se.TERM_CODE,
    se.SUBJECT_ID,
    se.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    se.MEET_PLACE,
    TRIM(se.MEET_PLACE) AS raw_place,
    se.ENROLLED
  FROM sections_enrollment se
),
place_components AS (
  SELECT
    p.SECTION_ID,
    p.TERM_CODE,
    p.SUBJECT_ID,
    p.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    p.MEET_PLACE,
    p.raw_place,
    p.ENROLLED,
    -- room: take trailing token after last dash if present, else trailing token after last space, else whole raw_place
    CASE
      WHEN p.raw_place LIKE '%-%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.raw_place, '-', -1))
      WHEN p.raw_place LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.raw_place, ' ', -1))
      ELSE TRIM(p.raw_place)
    END AS room,
    -- floor_guess: leading digits of the room token if present
    CASE
      WHEN (CASE
              WHEN p.raw_place LIKE '%-%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.raw_place, '-', -1))
              WHEN p.raw_place LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.raw_place, ' ', -1))
              ELSE TRIM(p.raw_place)
            END) REGEXP '^[0-9]+'
      THEN CAST(
             (CASE
                WHEN p.raw_place LIKE '%-%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.raw_place, '-', -1))
                WHEN p.raw_place LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.raw_place, ' ', -1))
                ELSE TRIM(p.raw_place)
              END) AS UNSIGNED
           )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS floor
  FROM parsed_place p
),
meeting_places AS (
  SELECT
    pc.SECTION_ID,
    pc.TERM_CODE,
    pc.SUBJECT_ID,
    pc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    pc.MEET_PLACE,
    pc.room,
    pc.floor,
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    aba.ADDRESS_LINE AS street_address,
    aba.CITY,
    aba.STATE_PROVINCE AS state,
    aba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    pc.ENROLLED
  FROM place_components pc
  LEFT JOIN fac_building b
    -- match on building number occurring in meet_place/raw_place when available
    ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER <> ''
    AND (
      pc.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', b.BUILDING_NUMBER, '%')
      OR pc.raw_place LIKE CONCAT('%', b.BUILDING_NUMBER, '%')
    )
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address aba
    ON aba.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    AND aba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
final_enroll AS (
  SELECT
    mp.TERM_CODE,
    mp.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    mp.room,
    mp.floor,
    mp.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    mp.street_address,
    mp.CITY,
    mp.state,
    mp.postal_code,
    mp.ENROLLED
  FROM meeting_places mp
)
SELECT
  DISTINCT
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  room AS ROOM,
  floor AS FLOOR,
  FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  street_address AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  CITY,
  state AS STATE,
  postal_code AS POSTAL_CODE,
  FORMAT(ENROLLED,0) AS ENROLLED_COUNT_FORMATTED,
  ENROLLED AS ENROLLED_COUNT
FROM final_enroll

rows.question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_building_core AS (
SELECT
  -- carry key so view is joinable
  f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,

  -- canonical long building name: prefer BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fall back to BUILDING_NAME
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`,''), NULLIF(f.`BUILDING_NAME`,'')) AS `BUILDING_NAME`,

  -- parsed year from DATE_BUILT (various formats). Try YEAR() on STR_TO_DATE with common formats; fall back to NULL.
  -- Lift format literals out of view: none allowed inside view body per instructions, so we attempt multiple parsings inline.
  NULLIF(
    CAST(
      COALESCE(
        -- try ISO-ish YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD or YYYYMMDD
        CASE
          WHEN f.`DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(-|/)[0-9]{1,2}(-|/)[0-9]{1,2}$'
            THEN YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(f.`DATE_BUILT`,'%Y-%m-%d'))
          WHEN f.`DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$'
            THEN YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(f.`DATE_BUILT`,'%Y%m%d'))
          WHEN f.`DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
            THEN CAST(f.`DATE_BUILT` AS UNSIGNED)
          WHEN f.`DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}(-|/)[0-9]{1,2}(-|/)[0-9]{4}$'
            THEN YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(f.`DATE_BUILT`,'%m-%d-%Y'))
          ELSE NULL
        END,
        NULL
      ) AS SIGNED
    ), 0
  ) AS `DATE_BUILT_YEAR`,

  -- core numeric attribute requested
  f.`NUM_OF_ROOMS`
FROM
  `fac_building` f
),
fac_building_employment_proxy AS (
SELECT
  fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
  COALESCE(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, fbc.`BUILDING_NAME`) AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  -- Primary proxy: explicit room count where available
  fb.`NUM_OF_ROOMS`,
  -- Additional size proxies that can be used to estimate employees
  fb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`,
  fb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`
FROM
  `fac_building` fb
LEFT JOIN
  `fac_building_core` fbc
    ON fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = fbc.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_NAME,
  DATE_BUILT_YEAR AS BUILT_YEAR,
  NUM_OF_ROOMS AS NUM_OF_EMPLOYEES
FROM fac_building_core
WHERE DATE_BUILT_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE_BUILT_YEAR < 1950
  AND BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND BUILDING_NAME <> ''
  AND NUM_OF_ROOMS IS NOT NULL
  AND NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100

rows.question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_identifier_aliases AS (
SELECT
  f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  f.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), NULLIF(f.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, '')) AS `BUILDING_name_canonical`
FROM
  `fac_building` f
),
cis_course_by_building_candidate AS (
SELECT
  f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- COURSE_ID: prefer SECTION_ID if available, else MASTER_SUBJECT_ID||':'||SECTION_ID, else SUBJECT_CODE||' '||SUBJECT_NUMBER
  COALESCE(ccso.`SECTION_ID`,
           NULLIF(CONCAT(ccso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,':',ccso.`SECTION_ID`),':'),
           NULLIF(CONCAT(ccso.`SUBJECT_CODE`,' ',ccso.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`), ' ')) AS `COURSE_ID`,
  -- COURSE_ID_TYPE: indicate which field produced COURSE_ID
  CASE
    WHEN ccso.`SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL AND ccso.`SECTION_ID` <> '' THEN 'SECTION_ID'
    WHEN ccso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND ccso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` <> '' AND ccso.`SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL AND ccso.`SECTION_ID` <> '' THEN 'MASTER_SUBJECT_ID:SECTION_ID'
    WHEN ccso.`SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND ccso.`SUBJECT_CODE` <> '' THEN 'SUBJECT_CODE_SUBJECT_NUMBER'
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS `COURSE_ID_TYPE`,
  ccso.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  ccso.`MEET_PLACE` AS `MEET_PLACE_RAW`
FROM
  course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
JOIN
  fac_building f
  ON (
    -- match MEET_PLACE raw text to building aliases from building_identifier_aliases view
    -- use simple LIKE matching: if MEET_PLACE contains alias (case-insensitive), consider it matched
    -- lift literal patterns out of view: none here; relying on MEET_PLACE and building aliases
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM building_identifier_aliases bia
      WHERE bia.`BUILDING_KEY` = f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
        AND ccso.`MEET_PLACE` IS NOT NULL
        AND ccso.`MEET_PLACE` <> ''
        AND (
          LOWER(ccso.`MEET_PLACE`) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(bia.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '%')
          OR LOWER(ccso.`MEET_PLACE`) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(bia.`BUILDING_name_canonical`), '%')
          OR LOWER(ccso.`MEET_PLACE`) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(bia.`BUILDING_key`), '%')
        )
    )
  )
WHERE
  ccso.`MEET_PLACE` IS NOT NULL
  AND ccso.`MEET_PLACE` <> ''
  -- ensure building key carried through
  AND f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_name_canonical AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE_ID) AS CIS_COURSE_COUNT
FROM building_identifier_aliases b
LEFT JOIN cis_course_by_building_candidate c
  ON c.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_name_canonical
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE_ID) > 0
ORDER BY CIS_COURSE_COUNT DESC

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_subject_session_core AS (
SELECT
  s.`SECTION_ID`                                                    AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
  -- SESSION_SEQUENCE: carry through any sequence/order if available; fall back to NULL
  NULL                                                               AS SESSION_SEQUENCE,
  -- SESSION_TITLE: use MEET_TIME or RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME or SECTION_ID as title fallback
  COALESCE(NULLIF(s.`MEET_TIME`, ''), NULLIF(s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`, ''), s.`SECTION_ID`) AS SESSION_TITLE,
  -- SESSION_LOCATION: use MEET_PLACE
  NULLIF(s.`MEET_PLACE`, '')                                         AS SESSION_LOCATION,
  -- SESSION_DATE: prefer LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE or empty string -> NULL; also consider MEET_TIME if it contains a date-like value
  NULLIF(s.`LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE`, '')                                 AS SESSION_DATE,
  -- HAS_SESSION_INFO: flag whether any of the key session-level fields are present (non-null/non-empty)
  CASE
    WHEN (NULLIF(s.`MEET_TIME`, '') IS NOT NULL)
      OR (NULLIF(s.`MEET_PLACE`, '') IS NOT NULL)
      OR (NULLIF(s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`, '') IS NOT NULL)
      OR (NULLIF(s.`LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE`, '') IS NOT NULL)
      THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END                                                                AS HAS_SESSION_INFO
FROM
  `course_catalog_subject_offered` AS s
WHERE
  -- restrict to IAP term rows: lift literal out of view (caller should supply the IAP term code when querying the view)
  1 = 1
GROUP BY
  s.`SECTION_ID`,
  s.`MEET_TIME`,
  s.`MEET_PLACE`,
  s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  s.`LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE`
)
SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS NUM_SESSIONS_HELD,
  SUM(sess.session_enrollment) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  MIN(sess.session_fee_min) AS MIN_FEE,
  MAX(sess.session_fee_max) AS MAX_FEE,
  SUM(sess.has_info_flag) AS SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
  SUM(1 - sess.has_info_flag) AS SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO
FROM iap_subject_sponsor s
JOIN (
  -- per sponsor+session aggregation to avoid double-counting sessions when there are multiple detail rows
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    -- enrollment: prefer numeric ATTENDANCE, else MAX_ENROLLMENT, else 0
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE), '') + 0,
      d.MAX_ENROLLMENT + 0,
      0
    ) AS session_enrollment,
    -- fee per session: take min and max of FEE across detail rows for the session (NULLs ignored)
    MIN(d.FEE) AS session_fee_min,
    MAX(d.FEE) AS session_fee_max,
    -- has session info flag from canonical sessions as 1/0
    CASE WHEN c.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_info_flag
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_session_core c

rows.question: What is the term code, term description, total number of IAP sessions, total fee collected, and minimum and maximum enrollment for each term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_subject_session_rows AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    `SESSION_SEQUENCE`,
    `SESSION_TITLE`,
    `SESSION_LOCATION`,
    `SESSION_DATE`,
    `SESSION_START_TIME`,
    `SESSION_END_TIME`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `iap_subject_session`
),
academic_term_description_preference AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ''), ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM `academic_terms_all` AS ata
  LEFT JOIN `academic_terms` AS at
    ON at.`TERM_CODE` = ata.`TERM_CODE`
),
iap_detail_agg AS (
  -- aggregate fees and enrollment stats per TERM_CODE from iap_subject_detail
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    SUM(COALESCE(`FEE`, 0)) AS TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED,
    MIN(`MAX_ENROLLMENT`) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
    MAX(`MAX_ENROLLMENT`) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT
  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`
),
iap_sessions_by_term AS (
  /*
    Count sessions per term. Prefer joining on the explicit session key when available:
    iap_subject_detail.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iap_subject_session.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.
    Some deployments store TERM_CODE in SESSION_LOCATION; include that fallback:
    count sessions where session's SESSION_LOCATION equals the TERM_CODE.
    Use DISTINCT session key (or SESSION_DATE+SESSION_LOCATION as fallback) to avoid double-count.
  */
  -- sessions linked by explicit session key
  SELECT
    sd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` sd
  JOIN iap_subject_session_rows sr
    ON sd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` IS NOT NULL
   AND sr.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` = sd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`
  WHERE sd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.`SESSION_DATE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sd.`TERM_CODE`

  UNION ALL

  -- sessions where SESSION_LOCATION stores TERM_CODE and no explicit key linkage exists.
  -- Count sessions whose SESSION_LOCATION matches a term code present in iap_subject_detail,
  -- but exclude those sessions already counted via explicit key by filtering sr.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NULL
  SELECT
    sd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.`SESSION_DATE` /* use SESSION_DATE as proxy for distinct session when key absent */) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT `TERM_CODE` FROM `iap_subject_detail` WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  ) sd
  JOIN iap_subject_session_rows sr
    ON sr.`SESSION_LOCATION` = sd.`TERM_CODE`
   AND sr.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` IS NULL
  WHERE sr.`SESSION_DATE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sd.`TERM_CODE`
),
iap_sessions_merged AS (
  -- sum any counts from the two methods per TERM_CODE
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    SUM(`TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS`) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS
  FROM iap_sessions_by_term
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`
)
SELECT
  d.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  atd.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(s.TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS, 0) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(d.TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED, 0) AS TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED,
  d.MIN_ENROLLMENT AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
  d.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS MAX_ENROLLMENT
FROM iap_detail_agg d
LEFT JOIN iap_sessions_merged s
  ON s.`TERM_CODE` = d.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN academic_term_description_preference atd
  ON atd.`TERM_CODE` = d.`TERM_CODE`
ORDER BY d.`TERM_CODE` ASC

rows.pred_sql:
WITH
building_name_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`BUILDING_NAME`), '') AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`BUILDING_NAME`), '') AS `BUILDING_NAME_LONG`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `buildings`
),
-- keep only rows that have both a meeting place and time (reduces volume)
iap_session_raw AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID` AS `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`MEET_PLACE`), '') AS `SESSION_LOCATION`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`MEET_TIME`), '') AS `SESSION_TIME_RAW`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(`MEET_TIME`, '-', 1)), '') AS `SESSION_START_RAW`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(`MEET_TIME`, '-', -1)), '') AS `SESSION_END_RAW`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(`MEET_PLACE`), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(`MEET_TIME`), '') IS NOT NULL
),
-- parse times using a few likely formats
iap_session_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    SESSION_LOCATION,
    SESSION_TIME_RAW,
    SESSION_START_RAW,
    SESSION_END_RAW,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SECTION_ID,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    COALESCE(
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_RAW, '%l:%i %p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_RAW, '%l:%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_RAW, '%H:%i'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_RAW, '%h%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_RAW, '%k%i')  -- fallback
    ) AS start_time_dt,
    COALESCE(
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_RAW, '%l:%i %p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_RAW, '%l:%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_RAW, '%H:%i'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_RAW, '%h%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_RAW, '%k%i')
    ) AS end_time_dt
  FROM iap_session_raw
),
-- compute durations (minutes), filter out negative/zero durations
iap_session_minutes AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    SESSION_LOCATION,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SECTION_ID,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    start_time_dt,
    end_time_dt,
    CASE
      WHEN start_time_dt IS NULL OR end_time_dt IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE (
        ((TIME_TO_SEC(TIME(end_time_dt)) - TIME_TO_SEC(TIME(start_time_dt)) + 86400) % 86400) / 60
      )
    END AS duration_minutes
  FROM iap_session_parsed
),
-- minimal subject detail (fee not available in schema; assume 0)
iap_subject_detail AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID` AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    `SUBJECT_ID` AS IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    0 AS FEE
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
)
SELECT
  s.SESSION_LOCATION AS SESSION_LOCATION,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) AS TOTAL_SUBJECT_COUNT,
  SUM(IFNULL(d.FEE,0)) AS TOTAL_FEE,
  MIN(ps.duration_minutes) AS SHORTEST_SESSION_MINUTES,
  MAX(ps.duration_minutes) AS LONGEST_SESSION_MINUTES
FROM (
  -- distinct sessions per location to reduce join volume
  SELECT DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, SESSION_LOCATION
  FROM iap_session_minutes
  WHERE SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
) s
LEFT JOIN building_name_candidates b
  ON s.SESSION_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NAME
  OR s.SESSION_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG
  OR s.SESSION_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
LEFT JOIN iap_session_minutes ps
  ON ps.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY s.SESSION_LOCATION, BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION

rows.question: What is the school code, school name, full name of the department, course level, total number of courses, and total number of degree-granting courses for each school code, department, and course level?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_course_description_rows AS (
  SELECT
    -- canonical course identifier
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.SUBJECT_CODE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dcc.SUBJECT_CODE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(cs.SUBJECT_CODE), '')),
      ' ',
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER), ''))
    ) AS COURSE,
    -- department code preference: cis_course_catalog, then course_catalog_subject_offered, then drupal
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')) AS DEPARTMENT,
    -- derive simple course level (first digit of numeric subject_number); else whole subject_number if non-numeric
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
        LEFT(COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER), 1)
      WHEN COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL THEN
        COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    -- degree-granting per spec: table.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' (only available on some sources) OR heuristic on grade type
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(dcc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, ''), NULLIF(cc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, ''), NULLIF(cs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, ''), '')) = 'Y' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(cc.GRADE_TYPE, cs.GRADE_TYPE, dcc.GRADE_TYPE, '')) IN ('G','GR','GRAD','GRADUATE') THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    -- carry keys for joinability
    COALESCE(cc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, cs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, dcc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS SUBJECT_NUMBER
  FROM cis_course_catalog AS cc
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS cs
    ON (
         (cc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = cc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
      OR (cc.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID)
      OR (cc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND cs.SUBJECT_CODE = cc.SUBJECT_CODE AND cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
    )
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS dcc
    ON (
         (cc.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND dcc.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID)
      OR (cc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND dcc.SUBJECT_CODE = cc.SUBJECT_CODE AND dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
    )
  WHERE
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.SUBJECT_CODE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dcc.SUBJECT_CODE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(cs.SUBJECT_CODE), '')) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER), '')) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')) IS NOT NULL
),
sis_department_dim AS (
  SELECT
    -- department code as canonical
    DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    -- department full name: lightweight proxy using distinct course identifiers
    LEFT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COURSE ORDER BY COURSE SEPARATOR ' / '), 200) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    -- school code: prefix of department code (up to 4 chars)
    LEFT(DEPARTMENT, 4) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    -- school name: reuse aggregated COURSE values as a lightweight proxy
    LEFT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COURSE ORDER BY COURSE SEPARATOR ' / '), 200) AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM sis_course_description_rows
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_CODE AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  s.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE) AS TOTAL_COURSES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN s.COURSE END) AS TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING_COURSES
FROM sis_course_description_rows s
JOIN sis_department_dim d
  ON s.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  s.COURSE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  d.SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  s.COURSE_LEVEL

rows.question: What are the different schools and departments that offer SIS courses? List their school code, school name, department code, department name, the total number of phone numbers, and the most common course level.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_department_basic AS (
  -- departments that offer SIS courses: sourced from sis_course_description.DEPARTMENT values
  SELECT
    sd.SCHOOL_CODE,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM sis_department sd
  WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sis_course_description s
      WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    )
),
phone_counts AS (
  -- distinct non-null phone numbers per department from sis_admin_department
  SELECT
    sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER), '')) AS phone_count
  FROM sis_admin_department sad
  GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
course_level_counts AS (
  -- counts of 'U' and 'G' per department from sis_course_description; ignore other values
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM sis_course_description s
  WHERE s.COURSE_LEVEL IN ('U','G')
  GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT, s.COURSE_LEVEL
),
dept_level_agg AS (
  -- pivot to get u_count and g_count per department (0 if missing)
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN c.cnt END), 0) AS u_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN c.cnt END), 0) AS g_count
  FROM course_level_counts c
  GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_CODE AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(p.phone_count, 0) AS PHONE_NUMBER_COUNT,
  -- determine most common between 'U' and 'G'; on tie choose alphabetically first
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(dl.u_count,0) > COALESCE(dl.g_count,0) THEN 'U'
    WHEN COALESCE(dl.g_count,0) > COALESCE(dl.u_count,0) THEN 'G'
    WHEN COALESCE(dl.u_count,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(dl.g_count,0) = 0 THEN
      -- no U/G present: attempt to pick smallest COURSE_LEVEL present for department (if any),
      -- otherwise NULL
      (
        SELECT COURSE_LEVEL
        FROM sis_course_description s2
        WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
          AND s2.COURSE_LEVEL IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY s2.COURSE_LEVEL
        LIMIT 1
      )
    ELSE
      -- tie: pick alphabetically first ('G' < 'U')
      LEAST('G','U')
  END AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_LEVEL
FROM sis_department_basic d
LEFT JOIN phone_counts p
  ON p.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_level_agg dl
  ON dl.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_CODE ASC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ASC

rows.question: What is the school code, school name, DLC key, the graduate level, total number of SIS subjects, the minimum and maximum course numbers, and the total number of departments offering subjects for each school?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_subject_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    -- SUBJECT_KEY
    COALESCE(cs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, dcc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, cis.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, csoa.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`) AS SUBJECT_KEY,
    -- TERM_CODE
    COALESCE(cs.`TERM_CODE`, dcc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`, cis.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`) AS TERM_CODE,
    -- SUBJECT_ID
    COALESCE(cs.`SUBJECT_ID`, dcc.`SUBJECT_ID`, cis.`SUBJECT_ID`, csoa.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    -- SUBJECT_ID_SORT
    COALESCE(
      cs.`PRINT_SUBJECT_ID`,
      dcc.`PRINT_SUBJECT_ID`,
      cis.`PRINT_SUBJECT_ID`,
      csoa.`PRINT_SUBJECT_ID`,
      COALESCE(cs.`SUBJECT_ID`, dcc.`SUBJECT_ID`, cis.`SUBJECT_ID`, csoa.`SUBJECT_ID`)
    ) AS SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    -- MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    COALESCE(cs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, dcc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, cis.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, csoa.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    -- COURSE_NUMBER
    NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(cs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, dcc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, cis.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, csoa.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`)), '') AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    -- COURSE_NUMBER_SORT (kept for possible downstream use)
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(cs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, dcc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, cis.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, csoa.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`) REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(cs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, dcc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, cis.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, csoa.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`), ' ', 1), 6, '0')
      ELSE COALESCE(cs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, dcc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, cis.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, csoa.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`)
    END AS COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    -- COURSE_SOURCE
    CASE
      WHEN cs.`SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL THEN 'course_catalog_subject_offered'
      WHEN dcc.`SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL THEN 'drupal_course_catalog'
      WHEN cis.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL THEN 'cis_course_catalog'
      WHEN csoa.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL THEN 'course_catalog_subject_offered_alt'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS COURSE_SOURCE,
    -- DEPARTMENT_CODE / NAME
    COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, cis.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, csoa.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, cis.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, csoa.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- SCHOOL_CODE (derive from department_code left of '-' if present)
    NULLIF(
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, cis.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, csoa.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`), '-', 1),
      ''
    ) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    -- SCHOOL_NAME (derive from department_name left of ' - ' if present, else whole department_name)
    NULLIF(
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, cis.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, csoa.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`), ' - ', 1),
      ''
    ) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- DLC_KEY (use department code as DLC key)
    COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, cis.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, csoa.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS DLC_KEY,
    -- GRADUATE_LEVEL flag
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(cis.`GRADE_TYPE_DESC`, dcc.`GRADE_TYPE_DESC`, cs.`GRADE_TYPE_DESC`, csoa.`GRADE_TYPE_DESC`)) LIKE '%GRADUATE%' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(cis.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, dcc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, cs.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, csoa.`SUBJECT_TITLE`)) LIKE '%GRADUATE%' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS GRADUATE_LEVEL,
    -- WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE (coalesce to allow GREATEST; fallback to low date)
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(cs.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '1970-01-01'),
      COALESCE(dcc.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '1970-01-01'),
      COALESCE(cis.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '1970-01-01'),
      COALESCE(csoa.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '1970-01-01')
    ) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dcc
    ON (
         (cs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND cs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = dcc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`)
         OR (cs.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND cs.`SUBJECT_ID` = dcc.`SUBJECT_ID`)
         OR (cs.`SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL AND cs.`SECTION_ID` = dcc.`SECTION_ID`)

  ) tens
) nums ON 1=1

  SELECT

      )
    ) AS author_trim

  )
),
-- counts to avoid duplication due to joins

),

LEFT JOIN td_counts ON td_counts.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN tm_counts ON tm_counts.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE

rows.question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
  -- prefer long name from fac_building, then buildings
  CASE
    WHEN fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fb.BUILDING_NAME) <> '' THEN fb.BUILDING_NAME
    WHEN b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(b.BUILDING_NAME) <> '' THEN b.BUILDING_NAME
    ELSE NULL
  END AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- prefer building number from fac_building then buildings
  CASE
    WHEN fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) <> '' THEN fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
    WHEN b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(b.BUILDING_NUMBER) <> '' THEN b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    ELSE NULL
  END AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  -- building height from fac_building if present, else fall back to buildings.BUILDING_COUNTER as string
  CASE
    WHEN fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) <> '' THEN fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT
    WHEN b.BUILDING_COUNTER IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS CHAR)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  -- street address: the original DDL shows fac_building has BUILDING_NAME but fac_building_address schema was truncated.
  -- use columns available: buildings table has BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS and BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS per DDL
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS AS MAILING_ADDRESS,
  -- city/state are not present in provided DDL for fac_building or buildings, so return NULLs
  NULL AS CITY,
  NULL AS STATE,
  -- HR department name: fac_building.COST_CENTER_CODE is the closest available field in fac_building
  fb.COST_CENTER_CODE AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- assignable and total sqft preferences: fac_building.ASSIGNABLE_AREA / EXT_GROSS_AREA else buildings' columns
  COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  -- average: if NUM_OF_ROOMS present use total/num_of_rooms, else if assignable present compute assignable (or fallback to total)
  CASE
    WHEN (COALESCE(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS, b.BUILDING_COUNTER) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS, b.BUILDING_COUNTER) > 0)
      THEN COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) / COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS,0), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_COUNTER,0))
    WHEN COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) IS NOT NULL
      THEN COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
    ELSE COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
  END AS AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM fac_building fb
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON (
       -- prefer matching building number when available
       (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
       -- otherwise try matching by building key
       OR (fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
       -- otherwise fallback to matching by name when both present
       OR (
         ( (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') OR (b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') )
         AND fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> ''
         AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> ''
         AND fb.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME
       )
     )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) DESC,
  COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) DESC,
  AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC

WITH fac_building_row AS (
  SELECT
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `COST_CENTER_CODE` AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    CASE
      WHEN `EXT_GROSS_AREA` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(CAST(`EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS CHAR)) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(`EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS DECIMAL(18,4))
    END AS `EXT_GROSS_AREA`,
    CASE
      WHEN `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(CAST(`ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS CHAR)) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(`ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS DECIMAL(18,4))
    END AS `ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`DATE_BUILT`), '') AS `DATE_BUILT`
  FROM `fac_building`
),
fac_building_hr_depts AS (
  -- distinct HR department names per building_key for later concatenation
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`
  FROM fac_building_row
  WHERE `BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
    AND `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL
),
building_area_agg_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    f.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    SUM(f.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`) AS `TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT`,
    SUM(f.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`) AS `TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT`,
    COUNT(f.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`) AS `ASSIGNABLE_AREA_RECORD_COUNT`
  FROM fac_building_row AS f
  WHERE f.`BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.`BUILDING_KEY`
)
SELECT
  fbr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fbr.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- concatenated distinct HR department names; NULL if none
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT hb.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME SEPARATOR '; ')
   FROM fac_building_hr_depts hb
   WHERE hb.BUILDING_KEY = fbr.BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  baa.TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT AS TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT,
  baa.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT,
  CASE
    WHEN baa.ASSIGNABLE_AREA_RECORD_COUNT IS NULL OR baa.ASSIGNABLE_AREA_RECORD_COUNT = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(baa.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT / baa.ASSIGNABLE_AREA_RECORD_COUNT, 2)
  END AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT,
  -- extract 4-digit year from DATE_BUILT formatted as '%m/%d/%Y'; return NULL if not parseable
  CASE
    WHEN fbr.DATE_BUILT IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN LOCATE('/', fbr.DATE_BUILT) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- take the substring after the last '/' and ensure it's a 4-digit number
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fbr.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1)) = 4
          AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(fbr.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
        THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fbr.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END
  END AS BUILT_YEAR
FROM (
  -- select distinct building rows so each building_key appears once with a representative BUILDING_NAME and DATE_BUILT
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    DATE_BUILT
  FROM fac_building_row
  WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME, DATE_BUILT
) AS fbr
LEFT JOIN building_area_agg_per_building baa
  ON baa.BUILDING_KEY = fbr.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY fbr.BUILDING_KEY ASC

  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(IFNULL(t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,'<NULL>'), ':', t.cnt) ORDER BY t.cnt DESC SEPARATOR '; ')
    FROM (
      SELECT so2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lr2
      LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered so2

    FROM (

  ON d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog cat
  ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = cat.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered so
  ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

  SELECT
    dc.SECTION_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS ENROLLED_COUNT
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dc

  AVG(cw.ENROLLED_COUNT) AS AVG_ENROLLED
FROM course_with_enroll cw

    `SCHOOL_CODE`,

  SELECT
    sso.SECTION_ID AS SOURCE_ROW_KEY,

        THEN CONCAT(NULLIF(sso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ''), ' ', NULLIF(sso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ''))
      WHEN NULLIF(sso.SUBJECT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL

--  - Ensure department identifiers are carried through consistently as requested.
--  - Use deterministic IS_DEGREE_GRANTING detection: prefer an explicit column named IS_DEGREE_GRANTING if present; otherwise use the heuristic from course/drupal catalogs.
--  - Order results by SCHOOL_CODE ascending as requested; because SCHOOL_CODE is coming from the ranked proxies, order by the minimum SCHOOL_CODE per department to satisfy "ORDER BY SCHOOL_CODE ASC".
WITH department_master AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(cc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE') THEN 'Y'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dr.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE') THEN 'Y'

  FROM (
    -- base set of departments from employee_directory (department number) and course catalogs
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM employee_directory
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  ) AS cc
    ON UPPER(TRIM(cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) = UPPER(TRIM(d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER))
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
  ) AS dr
    ON UPPER(TRIM(dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) = UPPER(TRIM(d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER))

  SELECT
    gp.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    gp.STUDENT_PROXY_ID,
    gp.SCHOOL_CODE,

  FROM graduate_proxy gp

  SELECT
    rp.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rp.STUDENT_PROXY_ID) AS GRADUATE_STUDENT_COUNT,

  GROUP BY rp.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  ON da.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dm.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
  lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
  lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID`,
  lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
  lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS`,
  lrmd.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` AS lrmd
JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` AS lrc
  ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
-- link subject/term info: prefer explicit keys on the detail row
LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` AS lso
  ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  AND COALESCE(lrmd.`TERM_CODE`, lso.`TERM_CODE`) = lso.`TERM_CODE`
  AND COALESCE(lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID`, lso.`SUBJECT_ID`) = lso.`SUBJECT_ID`
-- bring material status lookup (expose code and human value)
LEFT JOIN `library_material_status` AS lms
  ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
-- ensure required output columns are present by projecting from detail/lookup
WHERE lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND lrmd.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  sof.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS MIN_ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  SUM(sof.TOTAL_UNITS) AS SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM subject_offered_fall_cohort AS sof
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID
  FROM library_reserve_material_status_by_subject_term
  WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS = 'U'
) AS libu
  ON sof.TERM_CODE = libu.TERM_CODE
  AND sof.SUBJECT_ID = libu.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at
  ON sof.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY sof.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY sof.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

rows.question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name, the school name, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department, considering only departments that offer more than 5 unique subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dept_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cso
  GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
subject_enrollments AS (
  -- approximate enrollment by counting distinct SECTION_ID rows per subject within a department
  SELECT
    cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cso.SECTION_ID, CONCAT('NOSEC_', cso.SUBJECT_ID))) AS ENROLLED_COUNT
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cso
  GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS_OFFERED,
  AVG(se.ENROLLED_COUNT) AS AVG_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  VARIANCE(se.ENROLLED_COUNT) AS VARIANCE_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  STDDEV(se.ENROLLED_COUNT) AS STDDEV_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM dept_subjects d
JOIN subject_enrollments se
  ON se.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
-- exclude Chemistry (code '5') and Biology ('7'); require more than 5 unique subjects
WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5','7')
  AND d.NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS_OFFERED > 5
  -- require that at least one row for the department exists (already true) and that department offers degrees.
  -- The provided schema does not include IS_DEGREE_GRANTING; if that data existed in another table use it.
  -- Here we approximate "degree-granting" by requiring that DEPARTMENT_NAME is not null.
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS_OFFERED

rows.question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and also display the total number of rooms on that floor that meet these criteria? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
-- For each floor in the Stata building (BUILDING_KEY = '32' and BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'),
-- find the largest room square footage (>100) among rooms loaded on 19-DEC-24, one room name that has that largest sqft,
-- and the total count of rooms on that floor meeting those criteria.
WITH fac_building_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '') AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(b.`BUILDING_NAME`), '')
    ) AS `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM `fac_building` fb
  LEFT JOIN `buildings` b
    ON NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '')
),
per_floor_max AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    fr.`FLOOR`,
    MAX(fr.`ROOM_SQFT`) AS max_sqft
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  WHERE fr.`BUILDING_KEY` = '32'
    AND fr.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` = '19-DEC-24'
    AND fr.`ROOM_SQFT` > 100
  GROUP BY fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, fr.`FLOOR`
)
SELECT
  m.`FLOOR`,
  m.`max_sqft` AS MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  -- Choose one room name that has that max sqft on the floor (if multiple, pick the first via GROUP_CONCAT ordering)
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN r.`ROOM_SQFT` = m.`max_sqft` THEN r.`BUILDING_ROOM` END
      ORDER BY r.`ROOM_SQFT` DESC, r.`BUILDING_ROOM` SEPARATOR '||'
    ), '||', 1
  ) AS BUILDING_ROOM_WITH_MAX_SQFT,
  COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR
FROM per_floor_max m
JOIN `fac_rooms` r
  ON r.`BUILDING_KEY` = m.`BUILDING_KEY`
 AND r.`FLOOR` = m.`FLOOR`
 AND r.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` = '19-DEC-24'
 AND r.`ROOM_SQFT` > 100
JOIN fac_building_lookup dbl
  ON dbl.`BUILDING_KEY` = r.`BUILDING_KEY`
WHERE dbl.`BUILDING_KEY` = '32'
  AND dbl.`BUILDING_NAME` = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
GROUP BY m.`FLOOR`, m.`max_sqft`
ORDER BY m.`FLOOR`
